name: @chestor/roadmap-ui
title: Roadmap
description: Renderer web component for the Chestor roadmap workspace kind — one planning model shown through four lenses.

wippy.description: Renders one Chestor roadmap as <chestor-roadmap>. Pass entry-id with the workspace roadmap component id; mode may be preview (the default, compact read-only timeline) or full (lens switcher, timeline drag editing, horizons, strata, outcomes, inspector, undo/redo). The component reads and mutates the roadmap through the authenticated workspace roadmap API, subscribes to projection updates, and consumes no slotted content.

entry-id.description: Workspace roadmap component id to load; an empty value renders the required-id error state without issuing API requests.

mode.description: Rendering mode: preview for the compact read-only timeline, or full for the lens switcher, editing controls, inspector, and undo/redo.

read-only.description: Keeps the full reading surface available and disables changes for a shared reader.
